intro: New York's public sauna scene runs from the walk-in Russian & Turkish Baths in the East Village, which says it has served the city since 1892, to modern bathhouses with banyas, Finnish-style saunas and cold pools in Manhattan and Brooklyn. Brooklyn's World Spa has a large banya and many heat rooms, and QC NY puts saunas and outdoor heated pools on Governors Island. Most newer venues sell timed day passes online, so book ahead, while the Russian & Turkish Baths only takes walk-ins.

venues.name: Russian & Turkish Baths
venues.drop_in_price: $60 single admission (plus sales tax and card fees)
venues.schedule: Walk-in only, no reservations. 18+. Mostly co-ed, with men-only hours Thu 12-5pm and Sun 9am-2pm. Mon-Fri 12pm-10pm, Sat 10am-10pm, Sun 9am-10pm.
venues.notes: Five saunas and steam rooms, roof deck and restaurant. Robes, towels, shorts, slippers and lockers provided; you must be covered during co-ed hours. Two owners run alternating shifts, and passes only work on the shift of the owner you bought from.

venues.name: Bathhouse Flatiron
venues.drop_in_price: Day pass price varies by day and time; the site lists starting prices between $29 and $39
venues.schedule: Daily 8am-11:30pm. Timed day passes booked online. Aufguss (guided sauna) sessions daily.
venues.notes: Gas-furnace banya (185-195°F), dry sauna up to 185°F, steam room, infrared sauna, plus hot, neutral and salt pools. Massages and scrubs extra.

venues.name: Bathhouse Williamsburg
venues.schedule: Daily 8am-11:30pm. Timed day passes booked online. Complimentary guided sessions in the Event Sauna.
venues.notes: Stone-heated banya, dry sauna, tropical sauna, event sauna and steam room, plus hot and neutral pools and a rooftop pool and bar (open in winter as weather permits).

venues.name: Bathhouse Atlantic Ave
venues.schedule: Daily 8am-11:30pm. Timed day passes booked online. Complimentary Aufguss sessions.
venues.notes: Stone-heated banya, event sauna, year-round outdoor backyard sauna and heated backyard pool, steam room and infrared sauna. Canteen with light bites.

venues.name: World Spa
venues.session_length: Unlimited stay on standard passes; holiday passes limited to 4 hours
venues.schedule: 18+ only. Sun-Thu 10am-10pm, Fri-Sat 9am-11pm. Bring a bathing suit and indoor sandals; photo ID matching the purchase card required.
venues.notes: Grand Banya and Petite Banya (176-194°F), event sauna, clay and hay sauna, aroma sauna, Moroccan and Turkish hammams, snow room, salt room and pools. Valet parking $15. Robes and towels provided.

venues.name: QC NY
venues.address: 112 Andes Rd, Governors Island, New York, NY 10004
venues.drop_in_price: From $116 (3-hour morning entrance); from $124 (5 hours); from $158 (no time limit)
venues.session_length: 3 hours, 5 hours, or no time limit depending on ticket
venues.schedule: Sun-Thu 9am-10pm, Fri-Sat 9am-11pm. Reached by ferry to Governors Island.
venues.notes: Timber saunas, steam rooms, heated outdoor pools with skyline views, relaxation rooms and a bistro. Towels, robe and slippers included. Bring a bathing suit.

venues.name: Othership Flatiron
venues.session_length: 75 minutes (Free Flow and guided classes); 120 minutes (Evening Social)
venues.schedule: 18+. Booked sessions: self-guided Free Flow, quieter Free Flow, guided classes and evening socials. Alcohol-free.
venues.notes: Music-driven group sauna and ice bath sessions with guides. Intro packs for first-timers are listed on the site.

venues.name: Othership Williamsburg
venues.session_length: 75 minutes (Free Flow and guided classes); 120 minutes (Evening Social)
venues.schedule: 18+. Booked sessions: self-guided Free Flow, quieter Free Flow, guided classes and evening socials. Alcohol-free.
venues.notes: Near Domino Park. Music-driven group sauna and ice bath sessions with guides.
